svg.text: 1. Carry over the renderer unchanged; it already gives the same

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Bundle a pinned copy of the 3D viewer script in the package and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: copy it beside the 3D model file; the viewer page loads it from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: there, not from the internet (RDK-DDR-003, change P4, for R9).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Add the viewer script's license notice to the licensing file

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Stamp every image "concept, not for fabrication".
